x-m-el-job-02.title: Sheegidda isla xawaaraha laba cutub
x-m-el-job-02.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya beddelka u dhexeeya xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta (m) iyo xawaaraha saacad kasta (km), laftaada ka hel shuruudda labada qiimeba ay yihiin lambarro dabiici ah, oo sharax sababta.
x-m-el-job-02.material: Laba qof oo ka tirsan naadi orod ayaa u qeexay isla xawaaraha cutubyo kala duwan. Mid wuxuu yiri 'x m daqiiqad kasta' (masaafada la maray 1 daqiiqo), kan kalena wuxuu yiri 'y km saacad kasta' (masaafada la maray 1 saacad). Waxay rabaan inay tirooyinka u sheegaan lambarro dabiici ah oo keliya, iyadoo aan tobanle ama jajab jirin.
x-m-el-job-02.thinking.1: Samee dhowr tusaale oo buuxiya shuruud
x-m-el-job-02.thinking.2: Guud-ahee shuruudda ah in uu yahay lambar dabiici ah
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.1: Xawaaraha waxaa loo muujiyaa masaafada la maray isla inta waqti (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.prompt: Qiyaastii immisa mitir daqiiqad kasta ayuu yahay xawaaraha qof ku orda 6 km saacad kasta? Marka hore qiyaas cabbirka.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore u beddel masaafada la maray 1 saacad m.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.1: U qaybi masaafadaas 60 daqiiqo si aad u qiyaasto masaafada la maray 1 daqiiqo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii ay qaadato qiyaastii 10 daqiiqo si loo maro 1 km. Hubi jihada aad cutubyada ku beddelayso.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.c: 1000 m daqiiqad kasta waxay u dhigantaa 60 km saacad kasta. Hubi saamiga 1 daqiiqo iyo 1 saacad.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.explain: 6 km saacad kasta waa 6000 m 1 saacad, 1 saacad-na waa 60 daqiiqo, sidaas darteed waa qiyaastii 100 m 1 daqiiqo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 lammaane oo kala duwan oo lambarro dabiici ah, xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta x (m) iyo xawaaraha saacad kasta y (km), oo sameeya isla xawaaraha. Xawaaraha saacad kasta waa 6 ilaa 20 oo ay ku jiraan (baaxadda qof orod karo).
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ku muuji km masaafada la maray 1 saacad x m daqiiqad kasta.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hal xawaare saacad kasta dhig oo hubi haddii xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta uu yahay lambar dabiici ah.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.2: Haddii xawaaraha saacad kasta qaar aysan siin lambarro dabiici ah, raadi waxa xawaarahaas wadaagaan.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x iyo y waa inay noqdaan lambarro dabiici ah.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c2: x m daqiiqad kasta iyo y km saacad kasta ma aha isla xawaare. Barbar dhig masaafada la maray 1 saacad isla cutubka.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Xawaaraha saacad kasta wuxuu ku jiraa baaxadda.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Xawaaraha saacad kasta waa inuu noqdaa 6 ilaa 20 oo ay ku jiraan.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.explain: 100 m daqiiqad kasta waa 6000 m 1 saacad, sidaas darteed waa 6 km saacad kasta. Mar kasta oo xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta kordho 50 m, xawaaraha saacad kasta wuxuu kordhaa 3 km. Sidaas darteed 100/6, 150/9, 200/12, 250/15, 300/18 waa lammaannada suurtagalka ah.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sharax sababta 7 km ama 8 km saacad kasta aysan u shaqeynin, laakiin 6, 9 iyo 12 km ay shaqeeyaan.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Marka aad y km saacad kasta u beddesho xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta, wuxuu noqdaa jajab. Eeg waxa y u baahan yahay in uu noqdo si hooseeyuhu si siman u qaybsamo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Si toos ah u xisaabi xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta ee 7 iyo 8, oo hel sababta ay u noqdaan tobanlayaal.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Tusaale: Haddii aad xawaaraha saacad kasta u beddesho xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta, ...
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in lammaannada aad samaysay ay raacaan isla xeerka?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday sababta xeerka adigoo weydiinaya 'maxay 3 (ama 50) gaar ahaan?'
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.0: y km saacad kasta xawaaraha daqiiqad kasta waa 1000×y÷60 = 50y/3 m. Si ay u noqoto lambar dabiici ah, y waa inuu noqdaa jibbaar 3, sidaas darteed 6, 9, 12 way shaqeeyaan 7, 8-na ma shaqeeyaan.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.1: x m daqiiqad kasta waa 60x m = 0.06x km 1 saacad. Si labaduba u noqdaan tiro dhan, x waa inuu noqdaa jibbaar 50, markaas xawaaraha saacad kasta wuxuu kordhaa 3 mar kasta.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Beddelidda xawaaraha saacad kasta y daqiiqad kasta waxay siinaysaa 50y/3, sidaas darteed y waa inuu u qaybsamaa 3 si uu u noqdo lambar dabiici ah. 6, 9, iyo 12 way shaqeeyaan, 7 iyo 8-na ma shaqeeyaan.

x-m-el-job-10.topic: Xukunka haddii macluumaadku ku filan yahay
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid. Mar kasta, xukun adigoo isticmaalaya macluumaadka ilaa barta.
x-m-el-job-10.title: Doorashada Qorshaha Taleefanka: Ma Ku Filan Tahay Macluumaadka Hal Bil?
x-m-el-job-10.goal: Baro in xogta hal ama laba bilood aysan ku filnayn in lagu doorto qorshe, iyo in qorshaha ka fiican uu is beddelo marka isticmaalku is beddelo, oo hel xadka.
x-m-el-job-10.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad hadda ka dib isticmaasho mid ka mid ah laba qorshe oo taleefan. Qorshaha A wuxuu ku kacaa 30,000원 bishii wuxuuna ku jiraa ilaa 10 GB xog, 5,000원 GB kasta oo ka badan. Qorshaha B wuxuu ku kacaa 42,000원 bishii wuxuuna leeyahay xog aan xad lahayn. Isticmaalka waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa GB dhan oo keliya.
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga marka macluumaadku kordho
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.1: Hel shuruudda xadka (halka kala horreynta rogmato)
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.2: Xukun haddii muunad ku filan tahay
x-m-el-job-10.prereq.0: Muujinta kharashyada tibaaxo toosan (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.0: Qor kharashyada labada qorshe bil kasta oo barbar dhig wadarta.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.1: Qiyaas ku dhawaad halka isticmaalku yahay kharashyada A iyo B ay isku mid noqdaan.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Isticmaalka xogta bishii hore wuxuu ahaa 9 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Haddii aad doorato qorshe aad hadda ka dib isticmaasho, sidee ayaad u xukumi lahayd?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Bishii hore 9 GB, A waa 30,000원 B-na waa 42,000원, sidaas darteed A waa ka jaban yahay. Laakiin kani waa xog hal bil oo keliya ah.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: aan xad lahayn, sidaas darteed waan nasan karaa
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Dareenka nasashada wuu ka duwan yahay inuu ka jaban yahay. Xisaabi kharashka bishii hore labada qorshe.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: marka loo eego bishii hore, waa ka jaban yahay
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waa xog hal bil oo keliya, sidaas darteed weli way adag tahay in go'aan la gaaro
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Bishan waxaad daawatay muuqaallo badan oo waxaad isticmaashay 12 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Macluumaadka labadan bilood, sidee ayaad u dib u eegi lahayd xukunkaaga?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.after: 12 GB, A waa 30,000 + 2×5,000 = 40,000원, taasoo weli ka jaban B (42,000원). Xitaa marka aad dhaafto, B isla markiiba ka fiicnaan maayo.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ilaali A: bishan sidoo kale wuu ka jaban yahay
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: U beddel B: waxaad dhaaftay 10 GB, sidaas darteed B hadda wuu ka fiican yahay
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Dhaafidda 10 GB isla markiiba B kuma fiicnaynayso. Xisaabi kharashka qaddarka dheeraadka ah.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Xogta labada bilood weli waa goor hore
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Isticmaalka la filayo ee 4-ta bilood ee soo socota waa 8 GB, 13 GB, 14 GB iyo 15 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Qorshee ayaa leh wadarta kharash ugu hooseysa 4-taan bilood?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.after: A waa 30,000 + 45,000 + 50,000 + 55,000 = 180,000원 B-na waa 42,000×4 = 168,000원. A wuxuu u muuqday mid ka jaban labada bilood ee ugu horreeyay, laakiin marka bilo isticmaalku kordhay lagu daro, B waa ka jaban yahay.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kaliya A inuu bilaha qaarkood ka jaban yahay macnaheedu ma aha in wadartiisu ka jaban tahay. Xisaabi kharashka A bil kasta oo isku dar.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Go'aaminta inay isku mid yihiin intaadan helin wadarta waxay ka maqan tahay caddayn.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.reflect: Xogta hal bil iyo laba bilood, A wuxuu u muuqday mid ka wanaagsan, laakiin marka aad aragtay qaybinta isticmaalka mustaqbalka, xukunkaagu wuu is beddelay. Ka fikir macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee aad u baahan tahay intaadan xukunkaaga hagaajin, iyo isticmaalka qorshaha ka fiican uu is beddelo.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.prompt: Samee 2 qiimayaal oo kala duwan oo isticmaalka bishii x GB oo qorshaha B uu ka jaban yahay qorshaha A. (x waa tiro dhan oo ka mid ah 0 ilaa 40)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isku xigta xisaabi kharashka A marka x=10, 11, 12, 13.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.1: Hel halka x yahay marka kharashka A markii ugu horreysay dhaafo 42,000원.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c1: x waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo ka mid ah 0 ilaa 40.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Kharashka A wuu ka qaalisan yahay kan B.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Isticmaalkan, A wuu ka jaban yahay ama la mid yahay B. Sidoo kale ku dar kharashka qaddarka dheeraadka ah.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.explain: Kharashka A waa 30,000 + 5,000×(x−10). Wuxuu dhaafayaa 42,000원 marka x yahay 13 ama ka badan. Marka x=12 waa 40,000원 A-na weli wuu ka jaban yahay, marka 13 na waa 45,000원 B-na wuu ka jaban yahay.

x-m-el-job-05.title: Ku habboonaanta kala horreynta soo bandhigga shuruudaha
x-m-el-job-05.goal: Samee kala horreyn soo bandhig oo buuxiya dhammaan shuruudaha, oo sharax sida aad u tirisay wadarta kala horreynta suurtagalka ah adigoon midna seegin.
x-m-el-job-05.material:
Masraxa xafladda, naadiyada A, B, C iyo D mid kastaa wuxuu bandhigaa hal mar, mid mid. Shuruudaha waa sida soo socota.
① A ma noqon karo kan koowaad sababta qalabka loo dejinayo awgeed.
② D ma noqon karo kan ugu dambeeya sababta ballan kale awgeed.
③ Muuqaalka B wuxuu u noqdaa gadaasha bandhigga C, sidaa darteed B waa inuu bandhigaa ka hor C.
Tirada kala horreynta 1 waa kan koowaad 4 na waa kan ugu dambeeya.

x-m-el-job-05.thinking.2: Sharax sida aad ugu hubaysatay tirada

x-m-el-job-05.prereq.1: Aasaaska tirinta adigoo u kala qaybinaya (heerka xeerka isku-darka)
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.prompt: Haddii shuruudda ③ (B ka hor C) oo keliya la ilaaliyo, imisa kala horreyn soo bandhig ayaa jira 4-ta naadi wadar ahaan?
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore xusuuso imisa kala horreyn ayaa jira iyadoo aan shuruudo lahayn gabi ahaanba.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg waxa dhaca marka aad is-bedesho meelaha B iyo C ee kala horreyn.

x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.r.b: Dib u eeg sida aad u tirisay in xiriirka hore-iyo-dambe ee B iyo C uu u go'an yahay mid ka mid ah laba.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.explain: Waxaa jira 24 kala horreyn 4-ta naadi wadar ahaan, is-beddelka hore-iyo-dambe ee B iyo C na wuxuu lammaaneeyaa. Saxda badhkood, 12 hab, ayaa buuxiya shuruudda ③.

x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bilow dhigidda naadiga leh xaddidaadyada ugu badan.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka shaqee waxa ku dhaca meelaha hadhay haddii aad B dhigto 1.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.2: Ka dib markaad samayso kala horreyn, ku hubi shuruudaha ①, ② iyo ③ mid mid.

x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Tirooyinka kala horreynta waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dabiici ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 4.
